patch_description: Use exact LP results from already-scored networks to calibrate move screening against surrogate energy. For each fresh move, estimate its score from the LP-scored networks with the nearest energies, then blend that estimate with the energy ranking. Keep some batch slots for the best raw-energy moves and for random moves from the lower-energy-ranked tail. This lets the search exploit observed energy–LP relationships without relying on them exclusively, and preserves exploration when the surrogate is poorly correlated with true scores.
